high_level_description: The image is a promotional graphic for the Marvel Studios film "Spider-Man: Brand New Day." The background is predominantly black with the title of the movie prominently displayed at the top in bold red and blue letters. Below the title, the phrase "Brand New Day" is written in gold. In the center of the image, there is a circular inset featuring a person wearing a dark green suit jacket over a black shirt. The individual appears to be posing for the photo, though their face is not visible due to blurring.
